article: Windows 11で起動時にDPI設定が変わる場合の確認事項
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, including the claimed cause, UI steps, shutdown/restart distinction, reversibility, warning, metadata, and official references.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and retained 2024-04-29 as publication date; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Changed the headline and wording from a definite fix to a possible troubleshooting check; Microsoft documentation does not establish Fast Startup as the cause of multi-monitor scaling resets.
Explained that Fast Startup saves kernel and driver state during shutdown and disabling it may lengthen startup.
Added a shutdown-and-power-on test; Restart does not use Fast Startup.
Added steps to re-enable Fast Startup if the test does not help and replaced the Windows 10 manufacturer reference with current Microsoft sources.

post/マルチモニタで毎回起動時にDPIの設定がリセットされてしまうときの対処.source: post/マルチモニタで毎回起動時にDPIの設定がリセットされてしまうときの対処法/index.md
post/マルチモニタで毎回起動時にDPIの設定がリセットされてしまうときの対処.summary: Compared the full Japanese guide and twelve translations with current Microsoft Support and Learn documentation; reframed disabling Fast Startup as a reversible troubleshooting test because Microsoft does not establish it as the cause of scaling resets.

meaning.note: Compared the symptom claim and procedure; explicitly stated that Microsoft documentation does not confirm Fast Startup as the cause, and described disabling it only as a reversible diagnostic test.

terminology.note: Checked Windows 11, multi-monitor display scaling, Fast Startup, hibernation file, shutdown versus restart, Control Panel, Power Options, and localized settings labels in all language versions.

mathematics.note: The Windows troubleshooting guide contains no mathematical formulas or calculations.

code.note: The procedure uses Windows Control Panel settings and contains no executable code or commands.

links.note: Replaced the Windows 10 vendor help reference with Microsoft Support instructions for power settings and Microsoft Learn descriptions of power states and Fast Startup.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The DPI reset symptom was not reproduced on physical Windows 11 multi-monitor hardware; disabling Fast Startup is not a confirmed fix.
Menu names can vary by Windows display language and updates; disabling Fast Startup can lengthen startup time.
